units.source_text: 良清莫名其妙，心中想道：“在这猛烈的风波中，他怎么会发心乘船来访呢？”

en.t: Yoshikiyo was utterly bewildered and thought to himself, "In this violent storm, what could have moved him to come visiting by boat?"

units.source_text: 便上船与明石道人相见。

en.t: He then boarded the boat and met with the Akashi monk.

units.source_text: 道人言道：“以前，上巳日之夜，我梦见一个异样的人，叮嘱我来此相访。

en.t: The monk said, "Some time ago, on the night of the Third Day festival, I dreamed of a strange-looking person who told me earnestly to come here and visit.

units.source_text: 起初我不相信，后来再度梦见此人，对我说：‘到了本月十三日，你自会看到灵验。

en.t: At first I did not believe it, but later I dreamed of the same person again, and he said to me, 'When the thirteenth day of this month arrives, you will see the sign for yourself.

units.source_text: 那天风雨停息了，你必须前往须磨。’

en.t: On that day the wind and rain will cease, and you must go to Suma.'

units.source_text: 于是我试备船只，静候日期来到。

en.t: So I made ready a boat and quietly waited for the appointed day to come.

units.source_text: 后来果然风雨大作，雷电交加。

en.t: Afterward, just as foretold, the wind and rain grew violent, with thunder and lightning breaking out together.

units.source_text: 在外国朝廷，相信灵梦而赖以治国的前例甚多。

en.t: In foreign courts, there are many precedents for trusting sacred dreams and using them to govern the realm.

units.source_text: 因此之故，即使贵处不信此事，我亦当遵守梦中所示日期，乘船前来奉告。

en.t: For that reason, even if those here did not believe the matter, I felt I must observe the date shown in the dream and come by boat to report it.

units.source_text: 岂知今天果然刮起一股奇风，安抵此浦，与梦中神灵所示完全相符。

en.t: Who could have known that today a strange wind would indeed arise and bring me safely to this shore, exactly as the spirit in the dream had shown?

units.source_text: 我想贵处或许也有预兆，亦未可知。

en.t: I thought that there may perhaps have been some omen on your side as well.

units.source_text: 敢烦以此转达公子，唐突之处，不胜惶恐。”

en.t: I humbly ask you to convey this to the young lord; I am deeply ashamed of the suddenness of my request."
